prior_equivalence_audit.material_difference: RF-MCRB removes the fixed absolute float32 numerator margin from the original Euclidean closest-point operator. It computes the exact KKT coefficient, measures the displacement as represented in parameter dtype, and adds only a residual-derived relative-ULP refinement if the stored point remains unsafe. Unlike F2-01 it retains Euclidean geometry, providing a direct long-horizon comparison of numerical semantic repair versus Adam-coordinate repair.

unsb_object: the exact native Adam generator displacement constrained by a moving latent direction-covariance rate in Euclidean parameter geometry, with the actually committed parameter-dtype displacement required to satisfy the half-space
formula: Let a_k=grad_theta D_k and d0 be the realized native Adam generator displacement. If c=<a_k,d0><=0 or r=<a_k,a_k> is numerically zero, commit d0 byte-for-byte. Otherwise compute lambda_0=c/r in float64 and represent d(lambda_0)=d0-lambda_0 a_k in each parameter dtype. Measure rho=<a_k,d(lambda)> in float64. While rho>0, replace lambda by the next parameter-dtype-representable value above lambda+rho/r and recompute; fail closed after eight numerical refinements. Commit the first represented displacement with rho<=0. In exact arithmetic this is the unique argmin_d 1/2||d-d0||_2^2 subject to <a_k,d><=0; no fixed absolute margin is present.
identity_or_unbiased_condition: Every native displacement with nonpositive covariance-gap directional derivative and every zero tangent returns the original tensors unchanged. At d0=0 the operator is fixed. Unsafe corrections are scale-free in exact arithmetic, and numerical refinement depends only on directly measured represented infeasibility and a relative dtype ULP.
target_inaccessibility_proof: RF-MCRB reads only current unpaired bridge tensors, native latent/time draws, current netG, its recoverable EMA netG and the realized native Adam displacement. Numerical residual checks use only a_k and d0. Paired images, PSNR, SSIM, LPIPS, plain outputs, domain labels and confirmation20 are inaccessible.

falsifying_experiment: Kill as mathematically invalid if safe identity, represented feasibility, normal-scale invariance, correction proportionality, disabled plain identity, full-state resume, EMA recovery, RNG isolation or native Adam-moment preservation fails. Close this repaired Euclidean operator if its complete same-host matched seed2026 e200 trajectory fails the sustained gate; do not use the parent's paired trajectory to tune the repair.

ablation_definitions.proposal_only: Use the same moving covariance tangent as a norm-matched Euclidean negative proposal, removing the native-safe closest-point coefficient.
ablation_definitions.observable_only: Compute the moving tangent, exact coefficient and represented residual but commit native Adam unchanged.
ablation_definitions.projected_or_full: Commit native Adam exactly when safe; otherwise commit the residual-checked Euclidean closest feasible displacement without an absolute margin.

implementation_semantic_correction: Remove the scale-breaking fixed absolute numerator margin and enforce Euclidean half-space feasibility from the measured represented residual using only relative parameter-dtype ULP advancement. The real-arithmetic objective is unchanged, but the finite update is materially corrected.
